description: Puerto Rico's official holidays (the government's OATRH list plus federal observed dates from OPM) and what closes on each: Puerto Rico government offices and public schools, federal offices and post offices, banks, stores. Answers 'is today a holiday', 'what's the next holiday' and 'what's closed Monday'. Dates are Puerto Rico time; cite 787daily.com/holidays/ and the sources it returns.

date.description: A day to check, YYYY-MM-DD in Puerto Rico time; omit for today

year.description: List every holiday of this year; omit for the year of `date`

name: get_pr_holidays
